evals.name: check-is-read-only
evals.prompt: Run /knowledge:setup check in a repository whose CLAUDE.md declares a knowledge artifact convention, with the extraction node deps and Chromium not yet provisioned.
evals.expected_output: Reports a PASS/FAIL/INFO table: library_dir judged against the repository's declared convention (PASS on match, FAIL with the plugin-configuration remediation on mismatch), and the node-deps, Chromium, and OS media-tool probes reported as INFO with their remediations — without editing settings, writing config, or installing anything.
expectations: No settings file, pluginConfigs entry, or dependency install is written or run
Missing extraction deps and Chromium are INFO with remediation 'apply install-deps', not FAIL
library_dir convention is read from CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.claude/rules/artifact dirs, not inferred from .claude/topic-docs.yaml
Each FAIL row carries exactly one remediation line

evals.name: apply-mismatch-is-guidance-only
evals.prompt: Run /knowledge:setup apply where the observed library_dir is a machine-absolute path that contradicts the repository convention. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Routes the fix to Claude Code's own configuration surface — /plugin configure knowledge interactively, or headless a plain claude plugin install ... --config library_dir=<value> rerun at the scope claude plugin list reports — and rules out uninstalling to reconfigure; it never hand-edits pluginConfigs or Claude Code settings, and defers verification of the new value to a fresh session.
expectations: Does not write library_dir into any settings or pluginConfigs file

Headless path is a plain `claude plugin install ... --config` rerun against the already-installed plugin, carrying the CLI version the claim was verified on — the literal 2.1.240 — and scoping it to a non-sensitive option at user scope
Never prescribes `claude plugin uninstall` as the way to reconfigure, and gives the reason: uninstalling drops the whole stored pluginConfigs entry, resetting every option to its manifest default
Recommends a portable value form (~ prefix or env-var reference) over a literal machine path
Does not claim the changed value is in effect this session

evals.name: install-deps-verifies-by-reprobe
evals.prompt: Run /knowledge:setup apply install-deps on a machine where the vendored node deps and Chromium are absent but yt-dlp is also missing.
evals.expected_output: Runs both idempotent setup-deps.mjs provisioners (video-digest and course-digest) under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, then re-runs the check probes and reports their actual post-install results rather than trusting exit codes; for the missing yt-dlp it gives the platform install command only, installing no system packages and running no ingestion pipeline.
expectations: Both provisioners are invoked, not just one
Provisioned state is claimed only from re-run probe results, never from script exit codes alone
yt-dlp/ffmpeg/ImageMagick absence yields install guidance, not an attempted system install
